item: Hardware reasons, forensics notes and the reader page read in the page's language (row 206, part 2)
key_paths: src/shared_text.py; src/llm/backend.py; src/monitoring/forensics.py; src/static/reader.js; configs/server_text_unkeyed.tsv; tests/test_server_text_keyed.py
summary: said() gains nested frames (a hole holds another frame) and said_frames() (parts joined by a space); the page helper renders each part through the locale and labels the whole English when any part is not held. Keyed x12 (40 keys): AI hardware capability reasons and the probes' own reasons, session forensics methods and reasons, the reader's tone and mindmap notes. reader.js gets rdSaidHtml, a port of ooSaidHtml the node test checks against it case by case; the raw-print list is now page-built text only. A zero-slack per-file ratchet (configs/server_text_unkeyed.tsv: 904 bare English caveats/methods/reasons in 255 files, most report text) only goes down.
